AUTHOR: Connolly
TITLE: Improved Accuracy for Automated Counting of a Fish in Baited Underwater Videos for Stock Assessment
REGION: Bernier Island, Shark Bay, Gascoyne region, Western Australia
SPECIES: Australasian snapper (Chrysophrys auratus) target; Lutjanus vitta and L. carponotatus trained as look-alike classes
DATA: Own BRUVS footage (DPIRD survey, July 2019), 6 sites; 4,690 train/val annotations (3 sites), 3,627 test annotations (3 other sites)
V_EV: Methods, Dataset: 'Sites comprised mixed rock-sand habitats in 30–60 m water depth, where commercial fishers normally target snapper.'
D2: Train/val 80/20 from Sites 1,3,5; test from Sites 2,4,6
D_EV: Methods: 'We created a dataset for training and validation from videos at three sites (Sites 1, 3, and 5), and an independent dataset for testing from videos at the other three sites'
R_EV: Discussion: 'At this stage, the optimal procedure is addressed only for snapper at the multiple sites within the survey area in the Gascoyne region of Western Australia.'
C_EV: Methods: 'We tried CTs from 0 to 95% in 5% increments. Seq-NMS is a spatio-temporal filter... useful procedure where DL models are over-predicting'; Results: 'double and triple detection of the same individual fish'
E_EV: Results: 'A comparison of automated counts from the final revised modelling procedure against manual ground-truth counts gave an R2 of 88%.'
ARCH: Faster R-CNN (maskrcnn-benchmark), ResNet50 + Seq-NMS + polynomial corrective equation
METR: R2 of predicted vs manual N; MaxN and mean MaxN comparisons per site
NOTE: Site-level split within one July 2019 survey; per P2 no external test (authors explicitly flag domain shift as untested). C5 coded for explicit handling of double/triple detections of the same fish via Seq-NMS; threshold sweep 0-95% also reported (Supplementary Table 2). Cubic corrective equation is a count calibration, not a confidence calibration, so C2 = 없음. ENV: subtropical mixed rock-sand habitat at 30-60 m; no exact category, coded 온대 암반/켈프 - verifier check. Daytime deployments (0830-1630) not counted as illumination reporting (V3 NR). Intro mention of 'variable water clarity' is generic. TAXA coded 단일종 (single target) though model has 3 classes. Data statement: 'will be made available by the authors, without undue reservation'.
